name: @wildflowerhealthio/branding-core
description: Pure branding constants for Wildflower Health: site origin, section paths (the deploy contract), navigation link data, anchor-href resolution, and the per-app introduction copy shared by the homepage and the apps' landing pages, and the telemetry consent dialog's copy. Also the GitHub Pages 404 redirect restoration, which takes the `location`/`history` it acts on as a parameter. No DOM, no platform imports.
